# blocks/status-tray

## Type Aliases

### StatusTrayItem

```ts
type StatusTrayItem = Readonly<{
  id: string;
  label: ReactNode;
  count?: number;
  tone?: StatusTone;
  glyph?: StatusGlyph;
  motion?: StatusMotion;
  accessibleLabel?: string;
  title?: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  content: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  after?: ReactNode;
}>;
```

One footer readout and the small tray it opens. Semantic data only: the chip's
finish, the tray's material and the seam between them come from theme tokens
(`--caps-status-tray-*`), never from a prop.

---

### StatusTrayProps

```ts
type StatusTrayProps = Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title"> & object;
```

Controlled selection and structural slots for a row of footer trays.

#### Type Declaration

| Name               | Type                                           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`            | readonly [`StatusTrayItem`](#statustrayitem)[] | Readouts and their tray contents in display order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `openId`           | `string` \| `null`                             | Which tray is open. The host owns this state.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `onOpenChange()`   | (`id`) => `void`                               | Requests a selection change or dismissal.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `leading?`         | `ReactNode`                                    | Leading readouts that never open a tray (connection state, etc.).                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `trailing?`        | `ReactNode`                                    | Trailing controls after the chips (Send, Expand, …).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `renderTrigger()?` | (`props`) => `ReactNode`                       | Compose a native button trigger, forwarding these attributes, children and ref. StatusTray still owns disclosure, dismissal and return focus. Omit to retain the default chip and its theme-owned finish.                                                                                |
| `placement?`       | `"housing"` \| `"screen"` \| `"host"`          | Structural seat. `housing` sits on the plastic below a screen; `screen` sits inside a Display as flat, screen-native text (the wiki's screen material rule); `host` means a host's own chrome draws the chips, so only the open tray renders here. The look of each seat is theme-owned. |
| `align?`           | `"start"` \| `"end"`                           | Which edge the tray aligns to.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `hostInset?`       | `number`                                       | For `host` placement: where the host's trigger starts, in CSS pixels from this tray's inline start, so the open tray sits above it.                                                                                                                                                      |
